kallisto 0.52.0: kallisto (index, quant, inspect, version, cite)
Licence: BSD 2-Clause (LICENSE in this folder). Contains Bifrost (LICENSE.bifrost), BBHash/BooPHF
(LICENSE.BooPHF), CRoaring (LICENSE.CRoaring), libdivide (LICENSE.libdivide) and zlib 1.3.1 (LICENSE.zlib);
more notices in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt; the loader is Emscripten's runtime (MIT and NCSA: LICENSE.emscripten).
Upstream source: https://github.com/pachterlab/kallisto/tree/4e9f29cf3b021260415430c057a22469ca081391

Compiled to WebAssembly by the genomics-wasm project (https://github.com/comparativechrono/genomics-wasm,
commit e8c3e15): Emscripten 3.1.64, one thread, 64-bit values kept and lowered to 32-bit WebAssembly
(MEMORY64=2), without HDF5 and HTSlib (kallisto's own build options). Everything needed to build it again
is described in ../../../licenses/genomics-wasm-build/.

Changes to the source (tools/kallisto/browser.patch there): the threads of kallisto and Bifrost run their
work in order, on one thread (serial-thread.h); -t accepts only 1; a misspelt name in an unused part of
Bifrost is corrected. Indexing, pseudoalignment and the EM algorithm are unchanged. Without HDF5 the results
are abundance.tsv and run_info.json (no .h5 file; bootstraps with --plaintext), and there is no BAM output.
The loader (kallisto.js) was linked for the program runner of this site and records the exit status.

In the workbench's terminal, kallisto -t N (N > 1) is left out with a note.

Checked against kallisto 0.52.0 built natively from the same source (genomics-wasm's comparison: 29 of 29
cases with human and yeast reads; and in the workbench with the example data): the same abundance table.
The index files differ in their bytes – they do on Linux too, from one run of kallisto index to the next.
Bootstrap tables with a fixed seed are not the same as on Linux (genomics-wasm's README).
